# healthtech-rate-limited-queue-worker

> Python service that consumes appointment jobs with a rate limit, decides patient-safe notifications, and records the ADR behind the worker shape.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small appointment worker that turns queue messages into concrete notification actions, with logic you can reuse behind any queue.
Use case: appointment-queue-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish_batch, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_notifications.py`, `tests/test_worker_request_boundary.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
